ui.classroom.title: Singing classroom · Listen, sing, practise
ui.classroom.loaded: Loaded %1 lessons from files. Listen first, then sing.
ui.classroom.quiet: Microphone active: remain quiet for 2 seconds to measure ambient noise.
ui.classroom.calibrated: Noise calibrated: gate %1. Delay compensation is manual, not a measured device latency.
ui.classroom.replaying: Replaying this attempt. Practice history does not store audio.
ui.classroom.first_listen: Listen first; transpose to a comfortable range. Click the score or a result to select a phrase.
ui.classroom.retry_phrase: Phrase selected: listen again, then record another attempt.
ui.classroom.cancelled: Attempt cancelled. No score or history entry was created.
ui.classroom.listening: Listening: piano provides pitch guidance, not a vocal demonstration.
ui.classroom.heard: Example finished. Answer the question or sing after the count-in.
ui.classroom.countdown: Microphone active. Count-in: %1. Enter when Sing now appears.
ui.classroom.recording: Sing now · Microphone active; feedback follows automatically.
ui.classroom.hidden_live: Echo response: pitch hints remain hidden until submission
ui.classroom.completed: Feedback complete. Audio remains in this window; replay it or explicitly save it.
ui.classroom.summary: Time within pitch tolerance %1% · Notes with on-time entries/releases %2% · Reliable coverage %3%. Click a row to retry its phrase.
ui.classroom.unreliable: Reliable coverage is only %1%; no reliable score is available. Check level, noise and microphone placement. Missing notes and uncertain detection are reported separately.
ui.classroom.hidden: Target notation and pitch hints stay hidden until submission
ui.classroom.curve_legend: Blue: target · Orange: detected · Vertical axis: MIDI (2 semitones per grid)
ui.ear.answer: Select an answer; rhythm numbers show beats per note
ui.ear.choice_instruction: %1: use Listen to example below, then select an answer. The answer appears only after submission; listens are tracked separately.
ui.ear.echo_instruction: %1: listen, then use Sing into microphone after the example stops. Sing after the count-in. No target notation is shown before submission.
messages.lesson.read: File could not be read or exceeds 1 MiB
messages.lesson.index: Index requires schema=1 and a lessons array of 1–128 entries
messages.lesson.path: Lesson paths must remain within the selected folder and be unique
messages.lesson.fields: Check schema, unique integer id, score and practice
messages.lesson.exercises: earExercises requires 1–7 unique valid exercise types
messages.lesson.score: Score requires valid notes and timeline, at most 512 notes and no more than 110 seconds
messages.mic.native_error: Microphone operation failed (0x%1). Check the device connection and system microphone access settings.
messages.mic.format: Invalid or unsupported microphone sample format
messages.mic.overflow: Microphone processing buffer overflow; assessment stopped
messages.mic.platform: This microphone implementation uses Windows WASAPI
messages.mic.no_device: No microphone found. Connect one and refresh devices. Multiple-choice ear training remains available.
messages.mic.timeout: Microphone audio did not arrive within the time limit
messages.mic.late_start: Microphone started after the count-in; retry the attempt
messages.mic.discontinuity: Microphone audio was interrupted or changed format; assessment stopped
messages.mic.limit: Attempt is empty or exceeds 110 seconds; select a shorter phrase or increase speed
messages.mic.noisy: Ambient noise is too high. Calibration was not applied; remain quiet and recalibrate.
messages.mic.no_recording: There is no recording to save
messages.classroom.history_error: Practice history read/write failed; the original file is unchanged: %1
cli.classroom_check: Check lessons, ear training, pitch feedback and classroom UI
cli.microphone_check: Check real microphone capture (not singing accuracy)
ui.classroom.note_preview: Short note preview · equal attack strength; full playback remains stopped
